void ColorVocoderAudioProcessorEditor::updateBandViewVisibility()
{
    // Update button toggle states
    bandDistButton.setToggleState (currentBandView == BandViewMode::Distribution, juce::dontSendNotification);
    bandOffsetButton.setToggleState (currentBandView == BandViewMode::Offset, juce::dontSendNotification);
    perBandQButton.setToggleState (currentBandView == BandViewMode::PerBandQ, juce::dontSendNotification);

    // Update visibility
    bandDisplay.setVisible (currentBandView == BandViewMode::Normal);
    bandDistEditor.setVisible (currentBandView == BandViewMode::Distribution);
    bandOffsetEditor.setVisible (currentBandView == BandViewMode::Offset);
    perBandQCarousel.setVisible (currentBandView == BandViewMode::PerBandQ);

    repaint();
}

void ColorVocoderAudioProcessorEditor::updateQKnobVisibility()
{
    // Get current algorithm mode: 0=RITUAL, 1=LINKED, 2=SPLIT
    int mode = algorithmModeBox.getSelectedItemIndex();

    // Modulator Q knob only visible in SPLIT mode (mode == 2)
    bool showModQ = (mode == 2);
    modulatorQKnob.setVisible (showModQ);
    modulatorQLabel.setVisible (showModQ);

    // MOD BW (analysis bandwidth multiplier) visible in LINKED/RITUAL (the auto-derived-Q modes)
    bool showModBw = !showModQ;
    modBwKnob.setVisible (showModBw);
    modBwLabel.setVisible (showModBw);

    // Update carrier Q label: "Q" in RITUAL/LINKED, "CAR Q" in SPLIT
    carrierQLabel.setText (showModQ ? "CAR Q" : "Q", juce::dontSendNotification);

    // Trigger layout update if needed
    if (scaledContent)
        scaledContent->repaint();
}

//==============================================================================
// BandDisplay - MIDI Drag Export Implementation
//==============================================================================

juce::File BandDisplay::createMidiFileFromBands()
{
    // Get band frequencies and gains from processor
    const auto& bandGains = processor.getAllBandGains();
    int numBands = (int) displayFreqs.size();

    if (numBands == 0)
        return {};

    // Deduplicate: map MIDI note -> highest velocity
    // Multiple bands may map to the same MIDI note (especially with many bands)
    std::map<int, int> noteVelocityMap;

    for (int i = 0; i < numBands; ++i)
    {
        float freq = displayFreqs[(size_t) i];

        // Skip bands outside the active range
        if (freq < lowHz || freq > highHz)
            continue;

        // Skip notes that are excluded by user (e.g., clicking on keyboard to mute a note)
        int pitchClass = processor.frequencyToPitchClass (freq);
        if (processor.getNoteExclusion (pitchClass))
            continue;

        int midiNote = freqToMidiNote (freq);
        if (midiNote < 0 || midiNote > 127)
            continue;

        // Velocity from band gain (0-1 -> 1-127)
        float gain = (i < ColorVocoderAudioProcessor::maxBands) ? bandGains[(size_t) i] : 1.0f;
        int velocity = juce::jlimit (1, 127, juce::roundToInt (gain * 127.0f));

        // Keep highest velocity for each note
        auto it = noteVelocityMap.find (midiNote);
        if (it == noteVelocityMap.end() || velocity > it->second)
            noteVelocityMap[midiNote] = velocity;
    }

    if (noteVelocityMap.empty())
        return {};

    // Create MIDI file (Type 0 - single track, most compatible)
    juce::MidiFile midiFile;
    midiFile.setTicksPerQuarterNote (960);  // Higher resolution PPQ

    juce::MidiMessageSequence track;

    // Add tempo meta event (120 BPM = 500000 microseconds per quarter note)
    track.addEvent (juce::MidiMessage::tempoMetaEvent (500000), 0.0);

    // Add time signature (4/4)
    track.addEvent (juce::MidiMessage::timeSignatureMetaEvent (4, 4), 0.0);

    // Add all notes - 1 bar duration (4 beats = 3840 ticks at 960 PPQ)
    double noteDuration = 960.0 * 4.0;  // 1 bar

    for (const auto& [note, velocity] : noteVelocityMap)
    {
        track.addEvent (juce::MidiMessage::noteOn (1, note, (juce::uint8) velocity), 0.0);
        track.addEvent (juce::MidiMessage::noteOff (1, note, (juce::uint8) 0), noteDuration);
    }

    // End of track marker
    track.addEvent (juce::MidiMessage::endOfTrack(), noteDuration + 1.0);

    track.updateMatchedPairs();
    midiFile.addTrack (track);

    // Write to Desktop folder for reliability (temp files can be problematic with drag-drop)
    auto desktopDir = juce::File::getSpecialLocation (juce::File::userDesktopDirectory);
    auto exportDir = desktopDir.getChildFile ("BandRitual_MIDI");
    exportDir.createDirectory();

    auto midiFilePath = exportDir.getChildFile ("BandRitual_export.mid");

    // Delete old file if exists
    midiFilePath.deleteFile();

    // Write MIDI file
    juce::FileOutputStream outputStream (midiFilePath);
    if (outputStream.openedOk())
    {
        bool success = midiFile.writeTo (outputStream);
        outputStream.flush();

        if (success)
        {
            DBG ("MIDI file written to: " << midiFilePath.getFullPathName());
            DBG ("File size: " << midiFilePath.getSize() << " bytes, " << (int) noteVelocityMap.size() << " notes");
            return midiFilePath;
        }
    }

    DBG ("Failed to write MIDI file!");
    return {};
}

void BandDisplay::startMidiDrag (const juce::MouseEvent&)
{
    // Only start drag once (prevent multiple file creations)
    if (!midiDragStarted)
        return;

    midiDragStarted = false;  // Prevent re-entry

    // Create the MIDI file
    currentMidiFile = createMidiFileFromBands();

    if (!currentMidiFile.existsAsFile())
    {
        DBG ("Failed to create MIDI file for drag export");
        return;
    }

    DBG ("Starting MIDI drag with file: " << currentMidiFile.getFullPathName());

    // Perform the drag operation
    // File is kept on Desktop/BandRitual_MIDI/ for user reference
    juce::StringArray files;
    files.add (currentMidiFile.getFullPathName());

    juce::DragAndDropContainer::performExternalDragDropOfFiles (
        files,
        false,  // canMoveFiles = false (copy, don't move)
        this,
        nullptr  // No cleanup - file stays in BandRitual_MIDI folder
    );
}

// ==================== SCREENSHOT EXPORT (Cmd+Shift+E) ====================

void ColorVocoderAudioProcessorEditor::toggleEditMode()
{
    editModeActive = !editModeActive;
    processor.editModeActive.store (editModeActive);

    // Toggle visibility
    if (customChordEditor != nullptr)
        customChordEditor->setVisible (editModeActive);
    if (inputFilterDisplay != nullptr)
        inputFilterDisplay->setVisible (!editModeActive);
    if (pianoKeyboard != nullptr)
        pianoKeyboard->setVisible (!editModeActive);

    // Also hide EQ knobs in edit mode
    freqKnob.setVisible (!editModeActive);
    freqLabel.setVisible (!editModeActive);
    gainKnob.setVisible (!editModeActive);
    gainLabel.setVisible (!editModeActive);
    qKnob.setVisible (!editModeActive);
    qLabel.setVisible (!editModeActive);

    // Update EDIT button appearance
    editButton.setColour (juce::TextButton::buttonColourId,
                           editModeActive ? juce::Colour (0xFF2266AA) : juce::Colour (0xFF2A2A35));
    editButton.setColour (juce::TextButton::textColourOffId,
                           editModeActive ? juce::Colour (0xFF64D2FF) : juce::Colours::white);

    repaint();
}

bool ColorVocoderAudioProcessorEditor::keyPressed (const juce::KeyPress& key)
{
    // Cmd+Shift+E (Mac) or Ctrl+Shift+E (Windows) = Export screenshot
    auto mods = key.getModifiers();
    if (key.getKeyCode() == 'E' && mods.isCommandDown() && mods.isShiftDown())
    {
        exportScreenshot();
        return true;
    }

    // No-modifier keys
    if (!mods.isCommandDown() && !mods.isCtrlDown() && !mods.isAltDown())
    {
        int kc = key.getKeyCode();

        // Esc exits edit mode
        if (kc == juce::KeyPress::escapeKey && editModeActive)
        {
            toggleEditMode();
            return true;
        }

        // ===== EDIT MODE: letter keys select trigger keys =====
        if (editModeActive && customChordEditor != nullptr)
        {
            char upperKc = (char) juce::CharacterFunctions::toUpperCase ((juce::juce_wchar) kc);
            const char* validKeys = "QWERTYUASDFGHJZXCVBNM";
            if (juce::String (validKeys).containsChar (upperKc))
            {
                processor.lastTriggeredLetterKey.store (upperKc);
                customChordEditor->repaint();
                return true;
            }
            return false;
        }

        // ===== QWERTY CHORD TRIGGERING (only when orange M toggle is active) =====
        // M toggle itself is click-only (no keyboard shortcut)
        auto* midiChordParam = processor.apvts.getRawParameterValue ("midiChordTrigger");
        bool midiChordActive = midiChordParam ? (midiChordParam->load() > 0.5f) : false;

        if (midiChordActive)
        {
            // Home row A S D F G H J = chord degrees I-VII (0-6)
            int chordDegree = -1;
            switch (kc)
            {
                case 'A': case 'a': chordDegree = 0; break;
                case 'S': case 's': chordDegree = 1; break;
                case 'D': case 'd': chordDegree = 2; break;
                case 'F': case 'f': chordDegree = 3; break;
                case 'G': case 'g': chordDegree = 4; break;
                case 'H': case 'h': chordDegree = 5; break;
                case 'J': case 'j': chordDegree = 6; break;
            }

            if (chordDegree >= 0)
            {
                char upperKc = (char) juce::CharacterFunctions::toUpperCase ((juce::juce_wchar) kc);
                processor.lastTriggeredLetterKey.store (upperKc);

                if (auto* curDegreeParam = processor.apvts.getRawParameterValue ("chordDegree"))
                {
                    int oldDegree = (int) curDegreeParam->load();
                    if (auto* curVarParam = processor.apvts.getRawParameterValue ("chordVariation"))
                        processor.lastVariationPerDegree[(size_t) oldDegree] = (int) curVarParam->load();
                }

                if (auto* param = processor.apvts.getParameter ("chordDegree"))
                    param->setValueNotifyingHost ((float) chordDegree / 6.0f);

                if (auto* param = processor.apvts.getParameter ("chordVariation"))
                    param->setValueNotifyingHost ((float) processor.lastVariationPerDegree[(size_t) chordDegree] / 9.0f);

                if (processor.midiChordFirstPress)
                {
                    if (auto* param = processor.apvts.getParameter ("chordAmount"))
                        param->setValueNotifyingHost (1.0f);
                    processor.midiChordFirstPress = false;
                }

                return true;
            }

            // Top row Q W E R T Y U = chord variations 0-6
            int variation = -1;
            switch (kc)
            {
                case 'Q': case 'q': variation = 0; break;
                case 'W': case 'w': variation = 1; break;
                case 'E': case 'e': variation = 2; break;
                case 'R': case 'r': variation = 3; break;
                case 'T': case 't': variation = 4; break;
                case 'Y': case 'y': variation = 5; break;
                case 'U': case 'u': variation = 6; break;
            }

            if (variation >= 0)
            {
                if (auto* param = processor.apvts.getParameter ("chordVariation"))
                    param->setValueNotifyingHost ((float) variation / 9.0f);

                if (auto* curDegreeParam = processor.apvts.getRawParameterValue ("chordDegree"))
                    processor.lastVariationPerDegree[(size_t) (int) curDegreeParam->load()] = variation;

                return true;
            }

            // Number keys 0-9 = variation selection
            int numKeyVar = -1;
            if (kc >= '1' && kc <= '9')
                numKeyVar = kc - '1';
            else if (kc == '0')
                numKeyVar = 9;

            if (numKeyVar >= 0)
            {
                if (auto* param = processor.apvts.getParameter ("chordVariation"))
                    param->setValueNotifyingHost ((float) numKeyVar / 9.0f);

                if (auto* curDegreeParam = processor.apvts.getRawParameterValue ("chordDegree"))
                    processor.lastVariationPerDegree[(size_t) (int) curDegreeParam->load()] = numKeyVar;

                return true;
            }
        }

        // D/O/B band view shortcuts REMOVED — use click-only to avoid
        // conflicts when plugin is on a MIDI track in a DAW.
        // M toggle shortcut also REMOVED — click the orange M button instead.

        // Esc = Close any open section (return to Normal)
        if (kc == juce::KeyPress::escapeKey)
        {
            if (currentBandView != BandViewMode::Normal)
            {
                currentBandView = BandViewMode::Normal;
                updateBandViewVisibility();
                repaint();
                return true;
            }
        }
    }

    return false;
}

void ColorVocoderAudioProcessorEditor::exportScreenshot()
{
    // Create image at NATIVE resolution (unscaled)
    juce::Image screenshot (juce::Image::ARGB, NATIVE_WIDTH, NATIVE_HEIGHT, true);
    juce::Graphics g (screenshot);

    // Render the scaledContent (which contains all the UI at native resolution)
    if (scaledContent != nullptr)
    {
        scaledContent->paintEntireComponent (g, false);
    }

    // Save to Desktop
    auto desktop = juce::File::getSpecialLocation (juce::File::userDesktopDirectory);
    auto outputFile = desktop.getChildFile ("BandRitual_GUI_Screenshot.png");

    // Delete old file if exists
    if (outputFile.existsAsFile())
        outputFile.deleteFile();

    // Write PNG
    juce::FileOutputStream stream (outputFile);
    if (stream.openedOk())
    {
        juce::PNGImageFormat pngFormat;
        pngFormat.writeImageToStream (screenshot, stream);
        DBG ("Screenshot saved to: " << outputFile.getFullPathName());

        // Show confirmation (brief flash or just open the file)
        outputFile.revealToUser();
    }
}

================================================================================

#pragma once

#include <JuceHeader.h>
#include <vector>

/**
 * CarrierGenerator - Internal carrier signal generator for Band Ritual vocoder
 *
 * Supports multiple carrier modes:
 * - Self: Use modulator as carrier (original Band Ritual behavior)
 * - External: Use sidechain input as carrier
 * - Noise: White noise generator
 * - Saw: Sawtooth oscillator (POLYPHONIC - follows MIDI)
 * - Square: Square wave oscillator (POLYPHONIC - follows MIDI)
 * - Sine: Sine wave oscillator
 * - PitchTrack: Sawtooth that follows detected input pitch
 */
class CarrierGenerator
{
public:
    enum class Type
    {
        Self = 0,       // Use modulator as carrier (original behavior)
        External,       // Use sidechain input
        Noise,          // White noise
        Saw,            // Sawtooth wave (polyphonic MIDI)
        Square,         // Square wave (polyphonic MIDI)
        Sine,           // Sine wave
        PitchTrack      // Oscillator following input pitch
    };

    static constexpr int maxVoices = 16;  // Max polyphony

    CarrierGenerator();

    void prepare (double sampleRate, int samplesPerBlock);
    void reset();

    void setType (Type newType);
    void setFrequency (float freqHz);  // For monophonic/PitchTrack mode
    void setPitchFromInput (float detectedPitch);

    // Polyphonic MIDI support for Saw/Square modes
    void setMidiFrequencies (const std::vector<float>& frequencies);
    void clearMidiFrequencies();

    /**
     * Generate carrier signal into the output buffer.
     */
    void generateCarrier (juce::AudioBuffer<float>& outputBuffer,
                          const juce::AudioBuffer<float>* externalCarrier,
                          const juce::AudioBuffer<float>* modulatorForSelf);

    Type getCurrentType() const noexcept { return currentType; }

private:
    Type currentType = Type::Self;
    double sampleRate = 44100.0;

    // Monophonic oscillator state (for PitchTrack/Sine)
    float phase = 0.0f;
    float frequency = 440.0f;
    float phaseIncrement = 0.0f;
    float smoothedFrequency = 440.0f;
    float frequencySmoothing = 0.99f;

    // Polyphonic oscillator voices (for Saw/Square with MIDI)
    struct Voice {
        float phase = 0.0f;
        float frequency = 440.0f;
        float smoothedFrequency = 440.0f;
        bool active = false;
    };
    std::array<Voice, maxVoices> voices;
    int activeVoiceCount = 0;

    // Noise generator
    juce::Random noiseRandom;

    void updatePhaseIncrement();

    // Oscillator sample generators
    float generateSawSample();
    float generateSquareSample();
    float generateSineSample();
    float generateNoiseSample();

    // Polyphonic sample generators
    float generatePolySawSample();
    float generatePolySquareSample();

    JUCE_DECLARE_NON_COPYABLE_WITH_LEAK_DETECTOR (CarrierGenerator)
};

FILE: Source/CarrierGenerator.cpp
================================================================================

#include "CarrierGenerator.h"

CarrierGenerator::CarrierGenerator()
{
    for (auto& v : voices)
    {
        v.phase = 0.0f;
        v.frequency = 440.0f;
        v.smoothedFrequency = 440.0f;
        v.active = false;
    }
}

void CarrierGenerator::prepare (double sr, int /*samplesPerBlock*/)
{
    sampleRate = sr;
    smoothedFrequency = frequency;
    updatePhaseIncrement();

    // Frequency smoothing coefficient: ~5ms smoothing time
    frequencySmoothing = std::exp (-1.0f / (float) (sampleRate * 0.005));

    // Reset all voices
    for (auto& v : voices)
    {
        v.smoothedFrequency = v.frequency;
    }
}

void CarrierGenerator::reset()
{
    phase = 0.0f;
    smoothedFrequency = frequency;

    for (auto& v : voices)
    {
        v.phase = 0.0f;
        v.smoothedFrequency = v.frequency;
    }
}

void CarrierGenerator::setType (Type newType)
{
    currentType = newType;
}

void CarrierGenerator::setFrequency (float freqHz)
{
    frequency = juce::jlimit (20.0f, 20000.0f, freqHz);
}

void CarrierGenerator::setPitchFromInput (float detectedPitch)
{
    // For pitch tracking mode - set frequency from detected pitch
    if (currentType == Type::PitchTrack && detectedPitch > 20.0f)
        frequency = juce::jlimit (20.0f, 5000.0f, detectedPitch);
}

void CarrierGenerator::setMidiFrequencies (const std::vector<float>& frequencies)
{
    // Set polyphonic voices from MIDI note frequencies
    activeVoiceCount = juce::jmin ((int) frequencies.size(), maxVoices);

    for (int i = 0; i < maxVoices; ++i)
    {
        if (i < activeVoiceCount)
        {
            voices[i].frequency = frequencies[i];
            voices[i].active = true;
        }
        else
        {
            voices[i].active = false;
        }
    }
}

void CarrierGenerator::clearMidiFrequencies()
{
    activeVoiceCount = 0;
    for (auto& v : voices)
        v.active = false;
}

void CarrierGenerator::updatePhaseIncrement()
{
    phaseIncrement = smoothedFrequency / (float) sampleRate;
}

float CarrierGenerator::generateSawSample()
{
    // Sawtooth: ramp from -1 to 1
    float sample = 2.0f * phase - 1.0f;
    phase += phaseIncrement;
    if (phase >= 1.0f)
        phase -= 1.0f;
    return sample;
}

float CarrierGenerator::generateSquareSample()
{
    // Square wave: -1 or 1
    float sample = (phase < 0.5f) ? 1.0f : -1.0f;
    phase += phaseIncrement;
    if (phase >= 1.0f)
        phase -= 1.0f;
    return sample;
}

float CarrierGenerator::generateSineSample()
{
    // Sine wave
    float sample = std::sin (2.0f * juce::MathConstants<float>::pi * phase);
    phase += phaseIncrement;
    if (phase >= 1.0f)
        phase -= 1.0f;
    return sample;
}

float CarrierGenerator::generateNoiseSample()
{
    // White noise: random values between -1 and 1
    return noiseRandom.nextFloat() * 2.0f - 1.0f;
}

float CarrierGenerator::generatePolySawSample()
{
    if (activeVoiceCount == 0)
        return 0.0f;

    float mixedSample = 0.0f;

    for (int i = 0; i < activeVoiceCount; ++i)
    {
        auto& v = voices[i];
        if (!v.active) continue;

        // Smooth frequency to prevent clicks
        v.smoothedFrequency = frequencySmoothing * v.smoothedFrequency
                            + (1.0f - frequencySmoothing) * v.frequency;

        float phaseInc = v.smoothedFrequency / (float) sampleRate;

        // Generate saw sample for this voice
        float sample = 2.0f * v.phase - 1.0f;
        mixedSample += sample;

        // Advance phase
        v.phase += phaseInc;
        if (v.phase >= 1.0f)
            v.phase -= 1.0f;
    }

    // Normalize by number of voices (prevent clipping)
    return mixedSample / (float) activeVoiceCount;
}

float CarrierGenerator::generatePolySquareSample()
{
    if (activeVoiceCount == 0)
        return 0.0f;

    float mixedSample = 0.0f;

    for (int i = 0; i < activeVoiceCount; ++i)
    {
        auto& v = voices[i];
        if (!v.active) continue;

        // Smooth frequency to prevent clicks
        v.smoothedFrequency = frequencySmoothing * v.smoothedFrequency
                            + (1.0f - frequencySmoothing) * v.frequency;

        float phaseInc = v.smoothedFrequency / (float) sampleRate;

        // Generate square sample for this voice
        float sample = (v.phase < 0.5f) ? 1.0f : -1.0f;
        mixedSample += sample;

        // Advance phase
        v.phase += phaseInc;
        if (v.phase >= 1.0f)
            v.phase -= 1.0f;
    }

    // Normalize by number of voices (prevent clipping)
    return mixedSample / (float) activeVoiceCount;
}

void CarrierGenerator::generateCarrier (juce::AudioBuffer<float>& outputBuffer,
                                         const juce::AudioBuffer<float>* externalCarrier,
                                         const juce::AudioBuffer<float>* modulatorForSelf)
{
    const int numSamples = outputBuffer.getNumSamples();
    const int numChannels = outputBuffer.getNumChannels();

    // Handle External mode
    if (currentType == Type::External)
    {
        if (externalCarrier != nullptr && externalCarrier->getNumChannels() > 0)
        {
            // Copy external carrier to output
            for (int ch = 0; ch < numChannels; ++ch)
            {
                int srcCh = juce::jmin (ch, externalCarrier->getNumChannels() - 1);
                outputBuffer.copyFrom (ch, 0, *externalCarrier, srcCh, 0, numSamples);
            }
            return;
        }
        else
        {
            // No external carrier available - output SILENCE (standard vocoder behavior)
            // User needs to connect a sidechain input for External mode to work
            outputBuffer.clear();
            return;
        }
    }

    // Handle Self mode (original Band Ritual behavior)
    if (currentType == Type::Self)
    {
        if (modulatorForSelf != nullptr && modulatorForSelf->getNumChannels() > 0)
        {
            for (int ch = 0; ch < numChannels; ++ch)
            {
                int srcCh = juce::jmin (ch, modulatorForSelf->getNumChannels() - 1);
                outputBuffer.copyFrom (ch, 0, *modulatorForSelf, srcCh, 0, numSamples);
            }
            return;
        }
    }

    // Generate internal carrier
    for (int n = 0; n < numSamples; ++n)
    {
        float sample = 0.0f;

        switch (currentType)
        {
            case Type::Noise:
                sample = generateNoiseSample();
                break;

            case Type::Saw:
                // Use polyphonic if MIDI notes are held, otherwise monophonic
                if (activeVoiceCount > 0)
                    sample = generatePolySawSample();
                else
                {
                    // Fallback: monophonic at default frequency
                    smoothedFrequency = frequencySmoothing * smoothedFrequency
                                      + (1.0f - frequencySmoothing) * frequency;
                    updatePhaseIncrement();
                    sample = generateSawSample();
                }
                break;

            case Type::Square:
                // Use polyphonic if MIDI notes are held, otherwise monophonic
                if (activeVoiceCount > 0)
                    sample = generatePolySquareSample();
                else
                {
                    // Fallback: monophonic at default frequency
                    smoothedFrequency = frequencySmoothing * smoothedFrequency
                                      + (1.0f - frequencySmoothing) * frequency;
                    updatePhaseIncrement();
                    sample = generateSquareSample();
                }
                break;

            case Type::PitchTrack:
                // Monophonic, follows detected pitch
                smoothedFrequency = frequencySmoothing * smoothedFrequency
                                  + (1.0f - frequencySmoothing) * frequency;
                updatePhaseIncrement();
                sample = generateSawSample();
                break;

            case Type::Sine:
                smoothedFrequency = frequencySmoothing * smoothedFrequency
                                  + (1.0f - frequencySmoothing) * frequency;
                updatePhaseIncrement();
                sample = generateSineSample();
                break;

            default:
                sample = generateNoiseSample();
                break;
        }

        // Write to all channels
        for (int ch = 0; ch < numChannels; ++ch)
            outputBuffer.setSample (ch, n, sample);
    }
}

#pragma once

#include <JuceHeader.h>

class PresetManager
{
public:
    PresetManager (juce::AudioProcessorValueTreeState& apvts);

    // Get the directory where presets are stored
    juce::File getPresetDirectory() const;

    // Save current state as a preset
    bool savePreset (const juce::String& presetName);

    // Load a preset by name
    bool loadPreset (const juce::String& presetName);

    // Delete a preset by name
    bool deletePreset (const juce::String& presetName);

    // Get list of available preset names
    juce::StringArray getPresetList() const;

    // Get/set current preset name
    juce::String getCurrentPresetName() const { return currentPresetName; }
    void setCurrentPresetName (const juce::String& name) { currentPresetName = name; }

    // Get/set current preset folder ("" for root)
    juce::String getCurrentPresetFolder() const { return currentPresetFolder; }
    void setCurrentPresetFolder (const juce::String& folder) { currentPresetFolder = folder; }

    // Check if there are unsaved changes
    bool hasUnsavedChanges() const { return unsavedChanges; }
    void markAsModified() { unsavedChanges = true; }
    void markAsSaved() { unsavedChanges = false; }

    // Folder-aware preset management
    bool savePreset (const juce::String& presetName, const juce::String& folder);
    bool loadPreset (const juce::String& presetName, const juce::String& folder);
    bool deletePreset (const juce::String& presetName, const juce::String& folder);

    // Folder operations
    std::map<juce::String, juce::StringArray> getFolderOrganizedPresets() const;
    juce::StringArray getFolderList() const;
    bool createFolder (const juce::String& folderName);

    // File extension for presets
    static constexpr const char* presetExtension = ".brpreset";

private:
    juce::AudioProcessorValueTreeState& apvtsRef;
    juce::String currentPresetName { "Init" };
    juce::String currentPresetFolder;  // "" for root
    bool unsavedChanges = false;

    juce::File getPresetFile (const juce::String& presetName) const;
    juce::File getPresetFile (const juce::String& presetName, const juce::String& folder) const;

    JUCE_DECLARE_NON_COPYABLE_WITH_LEAK_DETECTOR (PresetManager)
};

//==============================================================================
// Implementation (header-only for simplicity)
//==============================================================================

inline PresetManager::PresetManager (juce::AudioProcessorValueTreeState& apvts)
    : apvtsRef (apvts)
{
    // Ensure preset directory exists
    getPresetDirectory().createDirectory();
}

inline juce::File PresetManager::getPresetDirectory() const
{
    // Store presets in user's Audio Presets folder (standard location)
    // macOS: ~/Library/Audio/Presets/BandRitual/
    // Windows: C:\Users\<user>\Documents\Audio Presets\BandRitual\

#if JUCE_MAC
    auto presetDir = juce::File::getSpecialLocation (juce::File::userHomeDirectory)
                        .getChildFile ("Library/Audio/Presets/BandRitual");
#elif JUCE_WINDOWS
    auto presetDir = juce::File::getSpecialLocation (juce::File::userDocumentsDirectory)
                        .getChildFile ("Audio Presets/BandRitual");
#else
    auto presetDir = juce::File::getSpecialLocation (juce::File::userApplicationDataDirectory)
                        .getChildFile ("BandRitual/Presets");
#endif

    return presetDir;
}

inline juce::File PresetManager::getPresetFile (const juce::String& presetName) const
{
    return getPresetDirectory().getChildFile (presetName + presetExtension);
}

inline bool PresetManager::savePreset (const juce::String& presetName)
{
    if (presetName.isEmpty())
        return false;

    auto file = getPresetFile (presetName);

    // Get current state as XML
    auto state = apvtsRef.copyState();
    std::unique_ptr<juce::XmlElement> xml (state.createXml());

    if (xml == nullptr)
        return false;

    // Write to file
    if (!xml->writeTo (file))
        return false;

    currentPresetName = presetName;
    unsavedChanges = false;
    return true;
}

inline bool PresetManager::loadPreset (const juce::String& presetName)
{
    auto file = getPresetFile (presetName);

    if (!file.existsAsFile())
        return false;

    // Read XML from file
    std::unique_ptr<juce::XmlElement> xml = juce::XmlDocument::parse (file);

    if (xml == nullptr)
        return false;

    // Check if valid state
    if (!xml->hasTagName (apvtsRef.state.getType()))
        return false;

    // Apply the state
    apvtsRef.replaceState (juce::ValueTree::fromXml (*xml));

    currentPresetName = presetName;
    unsavedChanges = false;
    return true;
}

inline bool PresetManager::deletePreset (const juce::String& presetName)
{
    auto file = getPresetFile (presetName);

    if (!file.existsAsFile())
        return false;

    return file.deleteFile();
}

inline juce::StringArray PresetManager::getPresetList() const
{
    juce::StringArray presets;

    auto dir = getPresetDirectory();
    if (!dir.isDirectory())
        return presets;

    // Find all preset files
    for (const auto& entry : juce::RangedDirectoryIterator (dir, false, juce::String ("*") + presetExtension))
    {
        presets.add (entry.getFile().getFileNameWithoutExtension());
    }

    presets.sort (true);  // Case-insensitive sort
    return presets;
}

//==============================================================================
// Folder-aware implementations
//==============================================================================

inline juce::File PresetManager::getPresetFile (const juce::String& presetName, const juce::String& folder) const
{
    if (folder.isEmpty())
        return getPresetDirectory().getChildFile (presetName + presetExtension);

    return getPresetDirectory().getChildFile (folder).getChildFile (presetName + presetExtension);
}

inline bool PresetManager::savePreset (const juce::String& presetName, const juce::String& folder)
{
    if (presetName.isEmpty())
        return false;

    // Ensure folder exists
    if (folder.isNotEmpty())
    {
        auto folderDir = getPresetDirectory().getChildFile (folder);
        folderDir.createDirectory();
    }

    auto file = getPresetFile (presetName, folder);

    auto state = apvtsRef.copyState();
    std::unique_ptr<juce::XmlElement> xml (state.createXml());

    if (xml == nullptr)
        return false;

    if (!xml->writeTo (file))
        return false;

    currentPresetName = presetName;
    currentPresetFolder = folder;
    unsavedChanges = false;
    return true;
}

inline bool PresetManager::loadPreset (const juce::String& presetName, const juce::String& folder)
{
    auto file = getPresetFile (presetName, folder);

    if (!file.existsAsFile())
        return false;

    std::unique_ptr<juce::XmlElement> xml = juce::XmlDocument::parse (file);

    if (xml == nullptr)
        return false;

    if (!xml->hasTagName (apvtsRef.state.getType()))
        return false;

    apvtsRef.replaceState (juce::ValueTree::fromXml (*xml));

    currentPresetName = presetName;
    currentPresetFolder = folder;
    unsavedChanges = false;
    return true;
}

inline bool PresetManager::deletePreset (const juce::String& presetName, const juce::String& folder)
{
    auto file = getPresetFile (presetName, folder);

    if (!file.existsAsFile())
        return false;

    return file.deleteFile();
}

inline std::map<juce::String, juce::StringArray> PresetManager::getFolderOrganizedPresets() const
{
    std::map<juce::String, juce::StringArray> result;

    auto dir = getPresetDirectory();
    if (!dir.isDirectory())
        return result;

    // Root-level presets (key = "")
    for (const auto& entry : juce::RangedDirectoryIterator (dir, false, juce::String ("*") + presetExtension))
        result[""].add (entry.getFile().getFileNameWithoutExtension());

    // Subfolder presets (1 level deep)
    for (const auto& folderEntry : juce::RangedDirectoryIterator (dir, false, "*", juce::File::findDirectories))
    {
        auto folderName = folderEntry.getFile().getFileName();
        auto& presets = result[folderName];

        for (const auto& presetEntry : juce::RangedDirectoryIterator (folderEntry.getFile(), false, juce::String ("*") + presetExtension))
            presets.add (presetEntry.getFile().getFileNameWithoutExtension());

        presets.sort (true);
    }

    // Sort root presets
    if (result.count (""))
        result[""].sort (true);

    return result;
}

inline juce::StringArray PresetManager::getFolderList() const
{
    juce::StringArray folders;

    auto dir = getPresetDirectory();
    if (!dir.isDirectory())
        return folders;

    for (const auto& entry : juce::RangedDirectoryIterator (dir, false, "*", juce::File::findDirectories))
        folders.add (entry.getFile().getFileName());

    folders.sort (true);
    return folders;
}

inline bool PresetManager::createFolder (const juce::String& folderName)
{
    if (folderName.isEmpty())
        return false;

    auto folderDir = getPresetDirectory().getChildFile (folderName);
    return folderDir.createDirectory().wasOk();
}

#pragma once

#include <JuceHeader.h>

//==============================================================================
/**
    FilmstripLookAndFeel - Renders rotary sliders using filmstrip images.

    Uses the Julian Behrens Analog GUI Kit 01 filmstrip knobs:
    - Big: 180x180 px per frame (128 frames)
    - Medium: 100x100 px per frame (128 frames)
    - Small: 70x70 px per frame (128 frames)
*/
class FilmstripLookAndFeel : public juce::LookAndFeel_V4
{
public:
    enum KnobSize
    {
        Big,    // 180x180 px
        Medium, // 100x100 px
        Small   // 70x70 px
    };

    FilmstripLookAndFeel();
    ~FilmstripLookAndFeel() override = default;

    /** Load filmstrip images from binary resources */
    void loadFilmstrips();

    /** Set which knob size to use for drawing */
    void setKnobSize (KnobSize size);

    /** Get current knob size */
    KnobSize getKnobSize() const noexcept { return currentSize; }

    //==============================================================================
    // LookAndFeel overrides

    void drawRotarySlider (juce::Graphics& g,
                           int x, int y, int width, int height,
                           float sliderPos,
                           float rotaryStartAngle,
                           float rotaryEndAngle,
                           juce::Slider& slider) override;

    /** Custom label font */
    juce::Font getLabelFont (juce::Label& label) override;

    /** Custom combo box styling */
    void drawComboBox (juce::Graphics& g, int width, int height,
                       bool isButtonDown, int buttonX, int buttonY,
                       int buttonW, int buttonH,
                       juce::ComboBox& box) override;

    void drawPopupMenuItem (juce::Graphics& g, const juce::Rectangle<int>& area,
                            bool isSeparator, bool isActive, bool isHighlighted,
                            bool isTicked, bool hasSubMenu,
                            const juce::String& text,
                            const juce::String& shortcutKeyText,
                            const juce::Drawable* icon,
                            const juce::Colour* textColour) override;

    /** Custom toggle button for complement, etc. */
    void drawToggleButton (juce::Graphics& g, juce::ToggleButton& button,
                           bool shouldDrawButtonAsHighlighted,
                           bool shouldDrawButtonAsDown) override;

    /** Custom text button styling */
    void drawButtonBackground (juce::Graphics& g, juce::Button& button,
                               const juce::Colour& backgroundColour,
                               bool shouldDrawButtonAsHighlighted,
                               bool shouldDrawButtonAsDown) override;

    /** Compact popup menu font */
    juce::Font getPopupMenuFont() override;

    /** Compact popup menu item size */
    void getIdealPopupMenuItemSize (const juce::String& text, bool isSeparator,
                                    int standardMenuItemHeight, int& idealWidth, int& idealHeight) override;

private:
    juce::Image bigKnob;
    juce::Image mediumKnob;
    juce::Image smallKnob;

    KnobSize currentSize = Medium;
    static constexpr int numFrames = 128;

    /** Get the appropriate filmstrip image for current size */
    juce::Image& getCurrentFilmstrip();

    /** Get frame height for current size */
    int getCurrentFrameHeight() const;

    JUCE_DECLARE_NON_COPYABLE_WITH_LEAK_DETECTOR (FilmstripLookAndFeel)
};

//==============================================================================
/**
    Convenience class that sets a specific knob size on construction.
    Use this to easily apply different sizes to different sliders.
*/
class BigKnobFilmstripLookAndFeel : public FilmstripLookAndFeel
{
public:
    BigKnobFilmstripLookAndFeel() { setKnobSize (Big); }
};

class MediumKnobFilmstripLookAndFeel : public FilmstripLookAndFeel
{
public:
    MediumKnobFilmstripLookAndFeel() { setKnobSize (Medium); }
};

class SmallKnobFilmstripLookAndFeel : public FilmstripLookAndFeel
{
public:
    SmallKnobFilmstripLookAndFeel() { setKnobSize (Small); }
};

#include "FilmstripLookAndFeel.h"
#include "BinaryData.h"

//==============================================================================
FilmstripLookAndFeel::FilmstripLookAndFeel()
{
    // Set dark color scheme
    setColour (juce::Slider::textBoxTextColourId, juce::Colour (0xFFE0E0E0));
    setColour (juce::Slider::textBoxOutlineColourId, juce::Colours::transparentBlack);
    setColour (juce::Slider::textBoxBackgroundColourId, juce::Colour (0xFF252530));

    setColour (juce::Label::textColourId, juce::Colour (0xFFE0E0E0));

    setColour (juce::ComboBox::backgroundColourId, juce::Colour (0xFF252530));
    setColour (juce::ComboBox::textColourId, juce::Colour (0xFFE0E0E0));
    setColour (juce::ComboBox::outlineColourId, juce::Colour (0xFF3A3A45));
    setColour (juce::ComboBox::arrowColourId, juce::Colour (0xFFE0E0E0));

    setColour (juce::PopupMenu::backgroundColourId, juce::Colour (0xFF1A1A1F));
    setColour (juce::PopupMenu::textColourId, juce::Colour (0xFFE0E0E0));
    setColour (juce::PopupMenu::highlightedBackgroundColourId, juce::Colour (0xFF3A3A45));
    setColour (juce::PopupMenu::highlightedTextColourId, juce::Colours::white);

    setColour (juce::TextButton::buttonColourId, juce::Colour (0xFF252530));
    setColour (juce::TextButton::textColourOnId, juce::Colour (0xFFE0E0E0));
    setColour (juce::TextButton::textColourOffId, juce::Colour (0xFFE0E0E0));

    setColour (juce::ToggleButton::textColourId, juce::Colour (0xFFE0E0E0));
    setColour (juce::ToggleButton::tickColourId, juce::Colour (0xFF64D2FF));
    setColour (juce::ToggleButton::tickDisabledColourId, juce::Colour (0xFF3A3A45));

    setColour (juce::GroupComponent::outlineColourId, juce::Colour (0xFF3A3A45));
    setColour (juce::GroupComponent::textColourId, juce::Colour (0xFFE0E0E0));

    // Load filmstrip images
    loadFilmstrips();
}

void FilmstripLookAndFeel::loadFilmstrips()
{
    // Load from binary resources (generated by JUCE from CMakeLists.txt)
    bigKnob = juce::ImageCache::getFromMemory (BinaryData::hise_knob_big_png,
                                                BinaryData::hise_knob_big_pngSize);

    mediumKnob = juce::ImageCache::getFromMemory (BinaryData::hise_Knob_medium_png,
                                                   BinaryData::hise_Knob_medium_pngSize);

    smallKnob = juce::ImageCache::getFromMemory (BinaryData::hise_knob_small_png,
                                                  BinaryData::hise_knob_small_pngSize);

    // Verify images loaded correctly
    jassert (bigKnob.isValid());
    jassert (mediumKnob.isValid());
    jassert (smallKnob.isValid());
}

void FilmstripLookAndFeel::setKnobSize (KnobSize size)
{
    currentSize = size;
}

juce::Image& FilmstripLookAndFeel::getCurrentFilmstrip()
{
    switch (currentSize)
    {
        case Big:    return bigKnob;
        case Small:  return smallKnob;
        case Medium:
        default:     return mediumKnob;
    }
}

int FilmstripLookAndFeel::getCurrentFrameHeight() const
{
    switch (currentSize)
    {
        case Big:    return 180;
        case Small:  return 70;
        case Medium:
        default:     return 100;
    }
}

//==============================================================================
void FilmstripLookAndFeel::drawRotarySlider (juce::Graphics& g,
                                              int x, int y, int width, int height,
                                              float sliderPos,
                                              float /*rotaryStartAngle*/,
                                              float /*rotaryEndAngle*/,
                                              juce::Slider& /*slider*/)
{
    auto& filmstrip = getCurrentFilmstrip();

    if (! filmstrip.isValid())
    {
        // Fallback: draw a simple circle if filmstrip not loaded
        g.setColour (juce::Colours::darkgrey);
        g.fillEllipse ((float) x, (float) y, (float) width, (float) height);
        return;
    }

    const int frameHeight = getCurrentFrameHeight();
    const int frameWidth = filmstrip.getWidth();  // Use actual image width

    // Calculate which frame to show based on slider position
    // sliderPos is 0.0 to 1.0, map to frame 0 to numFrames-1
    int frameIndex = juce::jlimit (0, numFrames - 1,
                                    (int) (sliderPos * (float) (numFrames - 1) + 0.5f));

    // Extract single frame from filmstrip
    int srcY = frameIndex * frameHeight;
    auto frame = filmstrip.getClippedImage ({ 0, srcY, frameWidth, frameHeight });

    // Calculate destination rectangle - center the knob in available space
    float size = (float) juce::jmin (width, height);
    float destX = (float) x + ((float) width - size) * 0.5f;
    float destY = (float) y + ((float) height - size) * 0.5f;

    // Draw the single frame scaled to fit
    g.drawImage (frame,
                 juce::Rectangle<float> (destX, destY, size, size),
                 juce::RectanglePlacement::centred);
}

//==============================================================================
juce::Font FilmstripLookAndFeel::getLabelFont (juce::Label& /*label*/)
{
    return juce::Font (juce::FontOptions (11.0f));
}

//==============================================================================
void FilmstripLookAndFeel::drawComboBox (juce::Graphics& g, int width, int height,
                                          bool isButtonDown, int /*buttonX*/, int /*buttonY*/,
                                          int /*buttonW*/, int /*buttonH*/,
                                          juce::ComboBox& box)
{
    auto bounds = juce::Rectangle<int> (0, 0, width, height).toFloat();
    auto cornerSize = 4.0f;

    // Background
    g.setColour (box.findColour (juce::ComboBox::backgroundColourId));
    g.fillRoundedRectangle (bounds, cornerSize);

    // Border
    g.setColour (box.findColour (juce::ComboBox::outlineColourId));
    g.drawRoundedRectangle (bounds.reduced (0.5f), cornerSize, 1.0f);

    // Arrow area
    auto arrowZone = bounds.removeFromRight ((float) height).reduced (8.0f);

    // Draw selected item text
    auto textBounds = bounds.reduced (6.0f, 0.0f);
    g.setColour (box.findColour (juce::ComboBox::textColourId));
    g.setFont (juce::Font (height * 0.55f));
    g.drawText (box.getText(), textBounds.toNearestInt(), juce::Justification::centredLeft, true);

    // Draw arrow
    juce::Path arrow;
    arrow.addTriangle (arrowZone.getCentreX() - 4.0f, arrowZone.getCentreY() - 2.0f,
                       arrowZone.getCentreX() + 4.0f, arrowZone.getCentreY() - 2.0f,
                       arrowZone.getCentreX(), arrowZone.getCentreY() + 3.0f);

    g.setColour (box.findColour (juce::ComboBox::arrowColourId)
                     .withAlpha (isButtonDown ? 1.0f : 0.7f));
    g.fillPath (arrow);
}

//==============================================================================
void FilmstripLookAndFeel::drawPopupMenuItem (juce::Graphics& g, const juce::Rectangle<int>& area,
                                               bool isSeparator, bool isActive, bool isHighlighted,
                                               bool isTicked, bool /*hasSubMenu*/,
                                               const juce::String& text,
                                               const juce::String& /*shortcutKeyText*/,
                                               const juce::Drawable* /*icon*/,
                                               const juce::Colour* /*textColour*/)
{
    if (isSeparator)
    {
        auto r = area.reduced (5, 0);
        r.removeFromTop (r.getHeight() / 2 - 1);
        g.setColour (juce::Colour (0xFF3A3A45));
        g.fillRect (r.removeFromTop (1));
        return;
    }

    auto textColourToUse = findColour (juce::PopupMenu::textColourId);

    if (isHighlighted && isActive)
    {
        g.setColour (findColour (juce::PopupMenu::highlightedBackgroundColourId));
        g.fillRect (area);
        textColourToUse = findColour (juce::PopupMenu::highlightedTextColourId);
    }

    g.setColour (textColourToUse.withAlpha (isActive ? 1.0f : 0.5f));
    g.setFont (12.0f);

    auto textArea = area.reduced (8, 0);

    if (isTicked)
    {
        // Draw checkmark
        auto tickArea = textArea.removeFromLeft (textArea.getHeight());
        g.drawText (juce::CharPointer_UTF8 ("\xe2\x9c\x93"), tickArea,
                    juce::Justification::centred);
    }

    g.drawFittedText (text, textArea, juce::Justification::centredLeft, 1);
}

//==============================================================================
void FilmstripLookAndFeel::drawToggleButton (juce::Graphics& g, juce::ToggleButton& button,
                                              bool shouldDrawButtonAsHighlighted,
                                              bool /*shouldDrawButtonAsDown*/)
{
    auto bounds = button.getLocalBounds().toFloat();

    // Background
    auto bgColour = button.getToggleState()
                        ? juce::Colour (0xFF64D2FF).withAlpha (0.3f)
                        : juce::Colour (0xFF252530);

    if (shouldDrawButtonAsHighlighted)
        bgColour = bgColour.brighter (0.1f);

    g.setColour (bgColour);
    g.fillRoundedRectangle (bounds, 4.0f);

    // Border
    g.setColour (button.getToggleState()
                     ? juce::Colour (0xFF64D2FF)
                     : juce::Colour (0xFF3A3A45));
    g.drawRoundedRectangle (bounds.reduced (0.5f), 4.0f, 1.0f);

    // Text
    g.setColour (button.getToggleState()
                     ? juce::Colours::white
                     : juce::Colour (0xFFE0E0E0));
    g.setFont (11.0f);
    g.drawText (button.getButtonText(), bounds, juce::Justification::centred);
}

//==============================================================================
void FilmstripLookAndFeel::drawButtonBackground (juce::Graphics& g, juce::Button& button,
                                                  const juce::Colour& backgroundColour,
                                                  bool shouldDrawButtonAsHighlighted,
                                                  bool shouldDrawButtonAsDown)
{
    auto bounds = button.getLocalBounds().toFloat();
    auto cornerSize = 4.0f;

    auto baseColour = backgroundColour;

    if (shouldDrawButtonAsDown)
        baseColour = baseColour.brighter (0.2f);
    else if (shouldDrawButtonAsHighlighted)
        baseColour = baseColour.brighter (0.1f);

    g.setColour (baseColour);
    g.fillRoundedRectangle (bounds, cornerSize);

    g.setColour (juce::Colour (0xFF3A3A45));
    g.drawRoundedRectangle (bounds.reduced (0.5f), cornerSize, 1.0f);
}

//==============================================================================
juce::Font FilmstripLookAndFeel::getPopupMenuFont()
{
    return juce::Font (juce::FontOptions (12.0f));
}

void FilmstripLookAndFeel::getIdealPopupMenuItemSize (const juce::String& text, bool isSeparator,
                                                       int /*standardMenuItemHeight*/,
                                                       int& idealWidth, int& idealHeight)
{
    if (isSeparator)
    {
        idealHeight = 10;
        idealWidth = 50;
    }
    else
    {
        idealHeight = 22;  // Compact item height
        idealWidth = getPopupMenuFont().getStringWidth (text) + 24;
    }
}

#pragma once

#include <JuceHeader.h>
#include <array>
#include <vector>

class STFTVocoder
{
public:
    static constexpr int kFFTOrder = 11;
    static constexpr int kFFTSize  = 1 << kFFTOrder;   // 2048
    static constexpr int kHopSize  = kFFTSize / 4;     // 512 (75% overlap)
    static constexpr int kNumBins  = kFFTSize / 2 + 1; // 1025

    STFTVocoder();

    void prepare (double sampleRate, int maxBlockSize);
    void reset();

    // Band configuration (set by PluginProcessor when bands change)
    struct BandInfo
    {
        float centerFreq  = 100.0f;   // Hz
        float lowFreq     = 80.0f;    // Hz — lower edge of band
        float highFreq    = 120.0f;   // Hz — upper edge of band
        float gain        = 1.0f;     // Combined per-band gain multiplier
        float analysisQ   = 2.0f;    // Analysis Q (for bandwidth correction)
        float chordGate   = 1.0f;    // Chord gate attenuation
        bool  isExcluded  = false;   // Note exclusion
        bool  isSecondary = false;   // Merged secondary band (skip processing)
    };

    void updateBands (const BandInfo* bands, int numBands);

    // Set envelope parameters (sample-rate coefficients; converted to frame-rate internally)
    void setEnvelopeParams (float attackCoeff, float releaseCoeff);

    // Process one block: modulator(mono) + carrier(stereo) → output(stereo)
    // Output is ADDED to outL/outR (not replaced), matching IIR accumulation pattern
    void process (const float* modulator,
                  const float* carrierL, const float* carrierR,
                  float* outL, float* outR,
                  int numSamples,
                  float depth,
                  float gateThresholdLinear, float gateGainLinear,
                  float gateAttackCoeff, float gateReleaseCoeff,
                  float globalNoisiness = 1.0f);

    // Analyze modulator only — compute per-band envelopes without processing carrier.
    // Used in hybrid mode: STFT envelope + IIR carrier.
    void processModulatorOnly (const float* modulator, int numSamples,
                               float depth, float globalNoisiness = 1.0f);

    // Get band envelope for GUI visualization or hybrid IIR carrier drive
    float getBandEnvelope (int bandIndex) const;

    // Get band noisiness for hybrid mode (drives IIR compensation chain)
    float getBandNoisiness (int bandIndex) const;

    int getLatencySamples() const { return kFFTSize; }

private:
    double sampleRate_ = 44100.0;

    // JUCE FFT processor
    juce::dsp::FFT fft_;

    // sqrt-Hann window (used for both analysis and synthesis)
    std::array<float, kFFTSize> window_;

    // COLA normalization factor (1 / sum_of_overlapping_windows)
    float colaNorm_ = 1.0f;

    // FFT magnitude normalization (2.0 / N)
    float fftNorm_ = 1.0f;

    // Circular input ring buffers (exactly fftSize long)
    std::array<float, kFFTSize> modRing_;
    std::array<float, kFFTSize> carRingL_;
    std::array<float, kFFTSize> carRingR_;
    int inputWritePos_ = 0;

    // Overlap-add output buffers (2x fftSize for safe circular overlap)
    static constexpr int kOLASize = kFFTSize * 2;
    std::array<float, kOLASize> olaL_;
    std::array<float, kOLASize> olaR_;
    int olaReadPos_ = 0;

    // Hop counter (counts down to next frame processing)
    int hopCounter_ = 0;

    // FFT scratch buffers (JUCE FFT needs 2*fftSize floats)
    std::array<float, kFFTSize * 2> modFFT_;
    std::array<float, kFFTSize * 2> carFFTL_;
    std::array<float, kFFTSize * 2> carFFTR_;

    // Output FFT buffers (pre-allocated to avoid stack allocation in processFrame)
    std::array<float, kFFTSize * 2> outFFTL_;
    std::array<float, kFFTSize * 2> outFFTR_;

    // Internal band data
    struct InternalBand
    {
        int   binLo            = 0;
        int   binHi            = 0;
        float centerFreq       = 100.0f;
        float noiseTilt        = 1.0f;  // sqrt(centerFreq / refFreq) — max tilt for noise
        float gain             = 1.0f;
        float chordGate        = 1.0f;
        float envelope         = 0.0f;
        float noisinessSmoothed = 1.0f;
        float gateGainSmoothed = 1.0f;
        bool  isExcluded       = false;
        bool  isSecondary      = false;
    };

    std::vector<InternalBand> bands_;
    int numBands_ = 0;
    float avgNoiseTilt_ = 1.0f;  // Mean of noiseTilt across bands (for normalization)

    // Frame-rate envelope coefficients (converted from sample-rate in setEnvelopeParams)
    float attackCoeffFrame_  = 0.0f;
    float releaseCoeffFrame_ = 0.0f;

    // Current frame parameters (set before processFrame, used inside it)
    float frameDepth_              = 1.0f;
    float frameGateThreshold_      = 0.0f;
    float frameGateGain_           = 0.0f;
    float frameGateAttackCoeff_    = 0.0f;
    float frameGateReleaseCoeff_   = 0.0f;
    float frameGlobalNoisiness_    = 1.0f;

    // Process one FFT frame (called every hopSize samples)
    void processFrame();

    // Process modulator-only FFT frame (envelope detection, no carrier)
    void processModulatorFrame();

    // Fast tanh approximation
    static inline float fastTanh (float x)
    {
        float x2 = x * x;
        return x * (27.0f + x2) / (27.0f + 9.0f * x2);
    }

    JUCE_DECLARE_NON_COPYABLE_WITH_LEAK_DETECTOR (STFTVocoder)
};

#include "STFTVocoder.h"
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>

STFTVocoder::STFTVocoder()
    : fft_ (kFFTOrder)
{
}

void STFTVocoder::prepare (double sampleRate, int /*maxBlockSize*/)
{
    sampleRate_ = sampleRate;

    // Build sqrt-Hann window
    for (int i = 0; i < kFFTSize; ++i)
    {
        float hann = 0.5f * (1.0f - std::cos (2.0f * juce::MathConstants<float>::pi
                                                * (float) i / (float) kFFTSize));
        window_[(size_t) i] = std::sqrt (hann);
    }

    // COLA normalization: sqrt-Hann × sqrt-Hann = Hann, 4 overlapping Hanns sum to 1.5
    colaNorm_ = 1.0f / 1.5f;

    // FFT amplitude normalization
    fftNorm_ = 1.0f / std::sqrt ((float) kFFTSize * 0.25f);  // 1/sqrt(N/4)

    reset();
}

void STFTVocoder::reset()
{
    modRing_.fill (0.0f);
    carRingL_.fill (0.0f);
    carRingR_.fill (0.0f);
    inputWritePos_ = 0;

    olaL_.fill (0.0f);
    olaR_.fill (0.0f);
    olaReadPos_ = 0;

    hopCounter_ = kFFTSize;

    for (auto& b : bands_)
    {
        b.envelope = 0.0f;
        b.noisinessSmoothed = 1.0f;
        b.gateGainSmoothed = 1.0f;
    }
}

void STFTVocoder::updateBands (const BandInfo* bands, int numBands)
{
    numBands_ = numBands;
    bands_.resize ((size_t) numBands);

    float binWidth = (float) sampleRate_ / (float) kFFTSize;

    // ===== CONTIGUOUS BIN ASSIGNMENT =====
    // Each bin is assigned to the nearest band (by log-space midpoints).
    // No gaps, no overlaps. Smooth carrier output.

    std::vector<float> logCenters ((size_t) numBands);
    for (int i = 0; i < numBands; ++i)
        logCenters[(size_t) i] = std::log2 (juce::jmax (20.0f, bands[i].centerFreq));

    for (int i = 0; i < numBands; ++i)
    {
        auto& ib = bands_[(size_t) i];

        float lowHz;
        if (i == 0)
            lowHz = juce::jmax (20.0f, bands[i].centerFreq * 0.7f);
        else
        {
            float logMid = 0.5f * (logCenters[(size_t) (i - 1)] + logCenters[(size_t) i]);
            lowHz = std::pow (2.0f, logMid);
        }

        float highHz;
        if (i == numBands - 1)
            highHz = juce::jmin ((float) (sampleRate_ * 0.45), bands[i].centerFreq * 1.4f);
        else
        {
            float logMid = 0.5f * (logCenters[(size_t) i] + logCenters[(size_t) (i + 1)]);
            highHz = std::pow (2.0f, logMid);
        }

        ib.binLo = juce::jmax (1, (int) std::round (lowHz / binWidth));
        ib.binHi = juce::jmin (kNumBins - 1, (int) std::round (highHz / binWidth));

        if (ib.binHi < ib.binLo)
            ib.binHi = ib.binLo;

        ib.centerFreq  = bands[i].centerFreq;
        ib.gain        = bands[i].gain;
        ib.chordGate   = bands[i].chordGate;
        ib.isExcluded  = bands[i].isExcluded;
        ib.isSecondary = bands[i].isSecondary;

        // Pre-compute the noise-optimal tilt correction for this band.
        // sqrt(f/ref) gives ~3 dB/octave — corrects the linear-vs-log frequency mismatch
        // that occurs when using contiguous FFT bins with per-bin RMS envelope.
        // For tonal (sine) signals, this correction should NOT be applied.
        // The blend is controlled by global spectral flatness in processFrame.
        constexpr float kTiltRefFreq = 4000.0f;
        ib.noiseTilt = std::sqrt (bands[i].centerFreq / kTiltRefFreq);

        // Note: bandwidth correction (contBW/iirBW) was attempted but reverted.
        // The Q value depends on mode/params, making correction fragile.
        // LOWBW +2-3 dB excess is accepted as structural (contiguous bins > IIR passband).
    }

    // Resolve overlaps: lower band wins
    for (int i = 1; i < numBands; ++i)
    {
        auto& prev = bands_[(size_t) (i - 1)];
        auto& curr = bands_[(size_t) i];
        if (curr.binLo <= prev.binHi)
            curr.binLo = prev.binHi + 1;
        if (curr.binLo > curr.binHi)
            curr.binHi = curr.binLo;
    }

    // Compute average noiseTilt for normalization.
    // When tilt is applied (noise), the average correction should be ~1.0 so that
    // the overall level matches the no-tilt case (sine).
    float tiltSum = 0.0f;
    int activeBands = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < numBands; ++i)
    {
        if (!bands_[(size_t) i].isExcluded && !bands_[(size_t) i].isSecondary)
        {
            tiltSum += bands_[(size_t) i].noiseTilt;
            activeBands++;
        }
    }
    avgNoiseTilt_ = (activeBands > 0) ? (tiltSum / (float) activeBands) : 1.0f;
}

void STFTVocoder::setEnvelopeParams (float attackCoeff, float releaseCoeff)
{
    attackCoeffFrame_  = std::pow (attackCoeff, (float) kHopSize);
    releaseCoeffFrame_ = std::pow (releaseCoeff, (float) kHopSize);
}

void STFTVocoder::process (const float* modulator,
                            const float* carrierL, const float* carrierR,
                            float* outL, float* outR,
                            int numSamples,
                            float depth,
                            float gateThresholdLinear, float gateGainLinear,
                            float gateAttackCoeff, float gateReleaseCoeff,
                            float globalNoisiness)
{
    frameDepth_            = depth;
    frameGateThreshold_    = gateThresholdLinear;
    frameGateGain_         = gateGainLinear;
    frameGateAttackCoeff_  = std::pow (gateAttackCoeff, (float) kHopSize);
    frameGateReleaseCoeff_ = std::pow (gateReleaseCoeff, (float) kHopSize);
    frameGlobalNoisiness_  = globalNoisiness;

    for (int i = 0; i < numSamples; ++i)
    {
        modRing_[(size_t) inputWritePos_]  = modulator[i];
        carRingL_[(size_t) inputWritePos_] = carrierL[i];
        carRingR_[(size_t) inputWritePos_] = carrierR[i];
        inputWritePos_ = (inputWritePos_ + 1) % kFFTSize;

        outL[i] += olaL_[(size_t) olaReadPos_];
        outR[i] += olaR_[(size_t) olaReadPos_];

        olaL_[(size_t) olaReadPos_] = 0.0f;
        olaR_[(size_t) olaReadPos_] = 0.0f;
        olaReadPos_ = (olaReadPos_ + 1) % kOLASize;

        hopCounter_--;
        if (hopCounter_ == 0)
        {
            processFrame();
            hopCounter_ = kHopSize;
        }
    }
}

void STFTVocoder::processFrame()
{
    // ===== 1. Window and extract from ring buffer =====
    for (int j = 0; j < kFFTSize; ++j)
    {
        int idx = (inputWritePos_ + j) % kFFTSize;
        float w = window_[(size_t) j];
        modFFT_[(size_t) j]  = modRing_[(size_t) idx] * w;
        carFFTL_[(size_t) j] = carRingL_[(size_t) idx] * w;
        carFFTR_[(size_t) j] = carRingR_[(size_t) idx] * w;
    }

    std::fill (modFFT_.begin() + kFFTSize, modFFT_.end(), 0.0f);
    std::fill (carFFTL_.begin() + kFFTSize, carFFTL_.end(), 0.0f);
    std::fill (carFFTR_.begin() + kFFTSize, carFFTR_.end(), 0.0f);

    // ===== 2. Forward FFT =====
    fft_.performRealOnlyForwardTransform (modFFT_.data());
    fft_.performRealOnlyForwardTransform (carFFTL_.data());
    fft_.performRealOnlyForwardTransform (carFFTR_.data());

    // ===== 3. Vocoder processing =====
    if (numBands_ > 0)
    {
        outFFTL_.fill (0.0f);
        outFFTR_.fill (0.0f);

        // RECALIBRATION FOR BW=10%: Start with neutral constants, measure raw shape.
        // Original HIGHBW values: kNoiseEnvComp=1.18, kTonalEnvComp=0.042
        constexpr float kNoiseEnvComp = 1.0f;   // neutral
        constexpr float kTonalEnvComp = 1.0f;   // neutral (was 0.042 for HIGHBW)

        for (int bi = 0; bi < numBands_; ++bi)
        {
            auto& band = bands_[(size_t) bi];

            if (band.isExcluded || band.isSecondary)
            {
                band.envelope = 0.0f;
                continue;
            }

            // --- Band envelope: flat per-bin RMS across contiguous bins ---
            float bandEnergy = 0.0f;
            float sumMag4 = 0.0f;
            int binCount = band.binHi - band.binLo + 1;

            for (int bin = band.binLo; bin <= band.binHi; ++bin)
            {
                float re = modFFT_[(size_t) (2 * bin)];
                float im = modFFT_[(size_t) (2 * bin + 1)];
                float mag2 = re * re + im * im;
                bandEnergy += mag2;
                sumMag4 += mag2 * mag2;
            }

            // --- Per-band participation ratio → noisiness ---
            // PR = (sum|X|²)² / (N × sum|X|⁴)
            // For complex Gaussian noise: E[PR] = (N+1)/(2N) ≈ 0.5
            // (|X_k|² is exponential → E[|X|⁴] = 2×E[|X|²]²)
            // Pure sine in 1 bin: PR = 1/N
            // Normalize between [1/N, (N+1)/(2N)] → [0, 1]
            // Per-band participation ratio for tonal/noise detection
            // Only reliable for bands with enough bins (>= 8)
            // Default: use global noisiness for small bands (< 8 bins can't detect locally)
            float noisiness = frameGlobalNoisiness_;
            if (binCount >= 8 && sumMag4 > 0.0f)
            {
                float N = (float) binCount;
                float pr = (bandEnergy * bandEnergy) / (N * sumMag4);
                float prSine  = 1.0f / N;
                float prNoise = (N + 1.0f) / (2.0f * N);
                noisiness = (pr - prSine) / (prNoise - prSine);
                noisiness = juce::jlimit (0.0f, 1.0f, noisiness);
            }

            // --- Dual RMS: geometric blend for N-independent tonal response ---
            // Linear blend of perBinRMS and totalRMS has N-dependent excess at
            // moderate noisiness (~0.18): excess ∝ 1/sqrt(N), causing +1-2 dB
            // at mid bands. Geometric blend reduces this dependency dramatically.
            // For noise (η=1): perBinRMS × kNoiseEnvComp (same as linear)
            // For tonal (η=0): totalRMS × kTonalEnvComp (same as linear)
            // For moderate η: pow(noiseRMS,η) × pow(tonalRMS,1-η)
            float perBinRMS = std::sqrt (bandEnergy / juce::jmax (1, binCount)) * fftNorm_;
            float totalRMS  = std::sqrt (bandEnergy) * fftNorm_;

            float noiseRMS = perBinRMS * kNoiseEnvComp;
            float tonalRMS = totalRMS * kTonalEnvComp;

            float bandRMS;
            if (noiseRMS > 1e-20f && tonalRMS > 1e-20f)
            {
                bandRMS = std::exp (noisiness * std::log (noiseRMS)
                                  + (1.0f - noisiness) * std::log (tonalRMS));
                // Guard against NaN/Inf from floating-point edge cases
                if (std::isnan (bandRMS) || std::isinf (bandRMS))
                    bandRMS = noisiness * noiseRMS + (1.0f - noisiness) * tonalRMS;
            }
            else
                bandRMS = noisiness * noiseRMS + (1.0f - noisiness) * tonalRMS;

            // --- Envelope follower (frame-rate) ---
            float env = band.envelope;
            if (std::isnan (bandRMS) || std::isinf (bandRMS))
                bandRMS = 0.0f;
            if (bandRMS > env)
                env = attackCoeffFrame_ * env + (1.0f - attackCoeffFrame_) * bandRMS;
            else
                env = releaseCoeffFrame_ * env + (1.0f - releaseCoeffFrame_) * bandRMS;
            if (std::isnan (env) || std::isinf (env))
                env = 0.0f;
            band.envelope = env;

            // --- Gate ---
            float gatedEnv = env;
            if (frameGateThreshold_ > 0.0f)
            {
                float targetGateGain = (env < frameGateThreshold_) ? frameGateGain_ : 1.0f;

                if (targetGateGain > band.gateGainSmoothed)
                    band.gateGainSmoothed = frameGateAttackCoeff_ * band.gateGainSmoothed
                                          + (1.0f - frameGateAttackCoeff_) * targetGateGain;
                else
                    band.gateGainSmoothed = frameGateReleaseCoeff_ * band.gateGainSmoothed
                                          + (1.0f - frameGateReleaseCoeff_) * targetGateGain;

                gatedEnv *= band.gateGainSmoothed;
            }
            else
            {
                band.gateGainSmoothed = 1.0f;
            }

            gatedEnv *= band.chordGate;

            // --- Depth + soft limiter ---
            float envGain = 1.0f - frameDepth_ + frameDepth_ * gatedEnv;
            if (envGain > 2.0f)
                envGain = 2.0f + fastTanh (envGain - 2.0f);

            float totalGain = envGain * band.gain;

            // --- Per-band adaptive tilt correction ---
            // Noise: sqrt(f/ref) brightens HF (corrects contiguous-bin energy distribution).
            // Tonal: pow(f/ref, -0.08) darkens HF (BR sine consistently brighter than Ableton).
            constexpr float kTonalTiltExp = -0.15f;
            constexpr float kTonalTiltRef = 4000.0f;
            float tonalTilt = std::pow (band.centerFreq / kTonalTiltRef, kTonalTiltExp);
            // RECALIBRATION: bin-count normalization for carrier output.
            // Output energy per band ∝ sqrt(binCount) (envGain normalizes by 1/sqrt(N)
            // but carrier sums N bins). Divide by sqrt(binCount) to flatten.
            float binNorm = 1.0f / std::sqrt ((float) juce::jmax (1, binCount));
            float finalGain = totalGain * binNorm;
            if (std::isnan (finalGain) || std::isinf (finalGain))
                finalGain = 0.0f;

            // --- Apply to carrier bins (flat, no Gaussian) ---
            for (int bin = band.binLo; bin <= band.binHi; ++bin)
            {
                float g = finalGain;
                int ri = 2 * bin;
                int ii = 2 * bin + 1;
                outFFTL_[(size_t) ri] += carFFTL_[(size_t) ri] * g;
                outFFTL_[(size_t) ii] += carFFTL_[(size_t) ii] * g;
                outFFTR_[(size_t) ri] += carFFTR_[(size_t) ri] * g;
                outFFTR_[(size_t) ii] += carFFTR_[(size_t) ii] * g;
            }
        }

        std::copy (outFFTL_.begin(), outFFTL_.end(), carFFTL_.begin());
        std::copy (outFFTR_.begin(), outFFTR_.end(), carFFTR_.begin());
    }

    // ===== 4. Inverse FFT =====
    fft_.performRealOnlyInverseTransform (carFFTL_.data());
    fft_.performRealOnlyInverseTransform (carFFTR_.data());

    // ===== 5. Synthesis window + overlap-add (with NaN guard) =====
    for (int j = 0; j < kFFTSize; ++j)
    {
        // Guard: replace NaN/Inf from IFFT with 0
        if (std::isnan (carFFTL_[(size_t) j]) || std::isinf (carFFTL_[(size_t) j]))
            carFFTL_[(size_t) j] = 0.0f;
        if (std::isnan (carFFTR_[(size_t) j]) || std::isinf (carFFTR_[(size_t) j]))
            carFFTR_[(size_t) j] = 0.0f;
        float w = window_[(size_t) j] * colaNorm_;
        int pos = (olaReadPos_ + j) % kOLASize;
        olaL_[(size_t) pos] += carFFTL_[(size_t) j] * w;
        olaR_[(size_t) pos] += carFFTR_[(size_t) j] * w;
    }
}

float STFTVocoder::getBandEnvelope (int bandIndex) const
{
    if (bandIndex >= 0 && bandIndex < numBands_)
        return bands_[(size_t) bandIndex].envelope;
    return 0.0f;
}

float STFTVocoder::getBandNoisiness (int bandIndex) const
{
    if (bandIndex >= 0 && bandIndex < numBands_)
        return bands_[(size_t) bandIndex].noisinessSmoothed;
    return 1.0f;
}

void STFTVocoder::processModulatorOnly (const float* modulator, int numSamples,
                                         float depth, float globalNoisiness)
{
    frameDepth_           = depth;
    frameGlobalNoisiness_ = globalNoisiness;

    for (int i = 0; i < numSamples; ++i)
    {
        modRing_[(size_t) inputWritePos_] = modulator[i];
        inputWritePos_ = (inputWritePos_ + 1) % kFFTSize;

        hopCounter_--;
        if (hopCounter_ == 0)
        {
            processModulatorFrame();
            hopCounter_ = kHopSize;
        }
    }
}

void STFTVocoder::processModulatorFrame()
{
    // ===== 1. Window and extract modulator from ring buffer =====
    for (int j = 0; j < kFFTSize; ++j)
    {
        int idx = (inputWritePos_ + j) % kFFTSize;
        modFFT_[(size_t) j] = modRing_[(size_t) idx] * window_[(size_t) j];
    }
    std::fill (modFFT_.begin() + kFFTSize, modFFT_.end(), 0.0f);

    // ===== 2. Forward FFT (modulator only) =====
    fft_.performRealOnlyForwardTransform (modFFT_.data());

    // ===== 3. Per-band envelope detection =====
    if (numBands_ <= 0) return;

    constexpr float kNoiseEnvComp = 1.18f;
    constexpr float kTonalEnvComp = 0.042f;

    for (int bi = 0; bi < numBands_; ++bi)
    {
        auto& band = bands_[(size_t) bi];
        if (band.isExcluded || band.isSecondary)
        {
            band.envelope = 0.0f;
            continue;
        }

        float bandEnergy = 0.0f;
        float sumMag4 = 0.0f;
        int binCount = band.binHi - band.binLo + 1;

        for (int bin = band.binLo; bin <= band.binHi; ++bin)
        {
            float re = modFFT_[(size_t) (2 * bin)];
            float im = modFFT_[(size_t) (2 * bin + 1)];
            float mag2 = re * re + im * im;
            bandEnergy += mag2;
            sumMag4 += mag2 * mag2;
        }

        // Noisiness detection (PR-based, global fallback for small bands)
        float noisiness = frameGlobalNoisiness_;
        if (binCount >= 8 && sumMag4 > 0.0f)
        {
            float N = (float) binCount;
            float pr = (bandEnergy * bandEnergy) / (N * sumMag4);
            float prSine  = 1.0f / N;
            float prNoise = (N + 1.0f) / (2.0f * N);
            noisiness = (pr - prSine) / (prNoise - prSine);
            noisiness = juce::jlimit (0.0f, 1.0f, noisiness);
        }

        // Smooth noisiness for IIR compensation chain
        band.noisinessSmoothed = 0.8f * band.noisinessSmoothed + 0.2f * noisiness;

        // Geometric dual RMS
        float perBinRMS = std::sqrt (bandEnergy / juce::jmax (1, binCount)) * fftNorm_;
        float totalRMS  = std::sqrt (bandEnergy) * fftNorm_;
        float noiseRMS = perBinRMS * kNoiseEnvComp;
        float tonalRMS = totalRMS * kTonalEnvComp;

        float bandRMS;
        if (noiseRMS > 1e-20f && tonalRMS > 1e-20f)
        {
            bandRMS = std::exp (noisiness * std::log (noiseRMS)
                              + (1.0f - noisiness) * std::log (tonalRMS));
            if (std::isnan (bandRMS) || std::isinf (bandRMS))
                bandRMS = noisiness * noiseRMS + (1.0f - noisiness) * tonalRMS;
        }
        else
            bandRMS = noisiness * noiseRMS + (1.0f - noisiness) * tonalRMS;

        if (std::isnan (bandRMS) || std::isinf (bandRMS))
            bandRMS = 0.0f;

        // Envelope follower
        float env = band.envelope;
        if (bandRMS > env)
            env = attackCoeffFrame_ * env + (1.0f - attackCoeffFrame_) * bandRMS;
        else
            env = releaseCoeffFrame_ * env + (1.0f - releaseCoeffFrame_) * bandRMS;
        if (std::isnan (env) || std::isinf (env))
            env = 0.0f;
        band.envelope = env;
    }
}

#pragma once

#include <JuceHeader.h>

// Forward declaration
class ColorVocoderAudioProcessor;
// Alias for convenience
using BandRitualAudioProcessor = ColorVocoderAudioProcessor;

//==============================================================================
/**
 * WebView-based GUI Editor for Band Ritual
 * Uses HTML/CSS/JS for the interface, rendered in an embedded browser
 *
 * Benefits:
 * - Design GUI with web technologies (easier styling, animations)
 * - Hot-reload during development (edit HTML/CSS/JS without recompiling)
 * - Modern look and feel with CSS
 * - Works in all major DAWs just like the regular C++ GUI
 */
class WebViewEditor : public juce::AudioProcessorEditor,
                      public juce::Timer
{
public:
    WebViewEditor(BandRitualAudioProcessor& processor);
    ~WebViewEditor() override;

    //==============================================================================
    void paint(juce::Graphics&) override;
    void resized() override;
    void timerCallback() override;

private:
    BandRitualAudioProcessor& audioProcessor;

    // WebView component
    std::unique_ptr<juce::WebBrowserComponent> webView;

    // Loading
    void loadWebUI();
    juce::String getEmbeddedHTML();

    // Parameter handling
    void sendParameterToWebView(const juce::String& paramId, float value);
    void sendParameterUpdatesToWebView();
    void sendBandLevelsToWebView();
    void sendSpectrumToWebView();

    // Message handling from WebView
    void handleWebViewMessage(const juce::String& message);

    // Size constraints
    static constexpr int DEFAULT_WIDTH = 1280;
    static constexpr int DEFAULT_HEIGHT = 740;
    static constexpr int MIN_WIDTH = 900;
    static constexpr int MIN_HEIGHT = 600;

    JUCE_DECLARE_NON_COPYABLE_WITH_LEAK_DETECTOR(WebViewEditor)
};
